decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen sits squarely within the firm's confectionery know-how, has repeatedly won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut, and is presented as a flagship, so the firm can clearly interpret and build on its success.

The dark barley malt rye bread builds on established baking knowledge and kept its own page in 2024 while sibling breads A, C and F were removed, which suggests the firm judged it the stronger performer.
The marzipan stollen is closely related to the award-winning stollen line and still had its own page in 2024, so it fits the firm's seasonal expertise and is likely to be kept.
